messages.author: 1f96330d3835f45a
messages.subject: log-likelihood for arbitrary parameters
parts:
Hei,

is it possible to get lavaan to calculate the log-likelihood for a specific and arbitrary set of parameter values (other than the fitted ones) for any model expressed in lavaan syntax? 
For example, say I would get the parameter estimates with `parameterEstimates(fit)` from a fitted lavaan-model and then change the values in the `est` column to something else (for example to explore how quickly the log-likelihood changes in the vicinity of the ML estimates). Would I be able to calculate the log-likelihood with this new set of parameters?

Thanks!

Matthias

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: log-likelihood for arbitrary parameters
parts:
Purpose?  Looking into fungibility?  

You can fix all the parameters in your syntax to whatever you want (or in a parameter table, which can be used instead of syntax).  Then "fit" the model to the data you want the log-likelihood for.  I provided an example to "update" the lavaan object here:

https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/issues/224

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
